column1: # Every partitioned table of schema public: table, partition key (pg_get_partkeydef), its BRIN index(es) or -, retention.
# retention: drop:N = a no-archive tick whose day is dropped after N whole past UTC days (viafrei@4dd794ab0 packages/ingest/src/platform/tick-retention-policy.ts TICK_DROP_KEEP_DAYS);

# archive:N = every other daily tick, kept N days (PARTITION_ARCHIVE_DAYS 14, fuel_prices 28 by PARTITION_ARCHIVE_TABLE_DAYS), then dumped to the cold store one day at a time (partition_archives) and dropped;
# rollup = ops_rollup_feed, kept by ops_rollup_refresh. Each drop:N and archive:N is also a partition_retention row (0305).
# A migration that partitions, re-keys or un-partitions a table changes its row here in the same commit.
